absence_claim_scope.claim: FM80 section 9 is the only registered gate specified enough to deliver a P-A or P-B verdict
absence_claim_scope.method: find by basename plus content grep, every negative paired with a control pattern required to match on the same files
controls_that_matched: grep -c parent on the three ME-X4 docs -> 20/11/4 where P-A/P-B returned 0
grep -c 'P-' on both paper READMEs -> 3 each where FM80 returned 0
find *E30* -> 5+ design files versus find *E80*|*E90* -> 1 unrelated file

ruled_out_as_second_gate.ME-X4: unrelated machine-epistemics study sharing vocabulary; its own receipt says the naturalistic cell is a separate unexecuted identity and nothing transfers to it; comparator is a TMS/ATMS parent federation not P-B typed-relation composition; already terminated PARENT_SUFFICIENT; protocol dated 2026-09-01 postdates the 2026-08-30 P-B brief that supposedly refers to it
ruled_out_as_second_gate.SD80: case-matrix intake feeding FM80; FM80 block receipt section 1 explicitly refuses to inherit its terminal
ruled_out_as_second_gate.conceptual_transfer_protocols: mention P-A/P-B only as merge targets and in an admission rule gating a different paper against them

why_e80_e90_cannot_substitute.prohibiting_clause_quote: inventing a new donor benchmark after the registered decisive cells are null
why_e80_e90_cannot_substitute.global_rule_quote: It may not create a new endpoint after outcome access merely to preserve a paper count.

clauses.4.4: an independent adjudicator accepts the donor is scientifically relevant, so REMOTE is not machine-decidable
clauses.7: at least two qualified adjudicators per domain who did not build the arm, blinded, plus a third for terminal disagreements
clauses.9.4: at least one winning domain contains genuinely REMOTE donors under section 4, inheriting 4.4
clauses.9.7: independent adjudication finds no stronger omitted parent collapsing the residual

human_gate_is_multiply_determined.people_required: six to nine qualified conflict-declared adjudicators independent of arm construction
human_gate_is_multiply_determined.compute_authorization_note: no amount of computation substitutes for a person who did not build the arm

machine_surrogate_for_remoteness.reason: section 4.4 makes REMOTE non-machine-decidable by construction; a surrogate would replace the clause rather than satisfy it, and section 9.4 would then be unsatisfiable in principle, manufacturing a negative

pre_outcome_design_correction.defect: sections 9.1 and 9.2 are jointly unsatisfiable at the section 8 registered sample
pre_outcome_design_correction.best_case_assumption: zero adverse discordance, a strict upper bound on achievable significance
pre_outcome_design_correction.consequence_if_unrepaired: a true effect at the bar satisfies 9.1, necessarily fails 9.2, and terminates on a section 10 contraction vocabulary that would read as an empirical negative

change_test.reason: swapping the exact paired test for a more permissive one after seeing this analysis would relax a frozen protocol, which section 12 forbids

pre_outcome_design_correction.verifier_self_test: 7/7 PASS including no-alarm controls and monotonicity

second_defect_reported_not_repaired.finding: the paper-side survival gates and FM80 are not bound to each other
second_defect_reported_not_repaired.evidence: grep -rln FM80 over the paper repo returns 7 files, none under the P-A or P-B directories; control grep -c 'P-' on both READMEs returns 3 each
second_defect_reported_not_repaired.risk: amending FM80 section 9 leaves four other documents silently stating the old conditions
second_defect_reported_not_repaired.not_repaired_reason: editing paper-side survival language is a manuscript act; this lane holds no claim authority over it

claimed: FM80 section 9 is the sole registered specified standalone survival gate for P-A and P-B
it is blocked on a human-adjudication precondition required independently by four of its clauses
no second registered gate is specified enough to substitute and specifying one now is prohibited by the portfolio's own frozen rescue rules
the gate as frozen carried a sample/effect-size defect that would have manufactured a negative, now corrected pre-outcome
not_claimed: no scientific verdict on either paper; no arm ran
not that a residual does not exist
not PARENT_SUFFICIENT, which is a terminal only for a study that ran
not that the papers should be reopened, and not that they should be released

existing_evidence_undisturbed.P-B: generated relation battery protected null retained: full interface 99/112, simple/static 100/112, paired exact McNemar p >= 0.75
